paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The average performance of all models on Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness categories.
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the average performance of various language models across three evaluation categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. Each category is represented by a separate horizontal bar chart, with models listed along the vertical axis in descending order of their performance in the Understanding category. The horizontal axis represents the performance score, ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at 20% intervals. In the Understanding category, the model gpt-4o-2024-11-20 achieves the highest score of 98.0, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 91.7, and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 at 71.2. In the Reasoning category, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 again leads with a score of 66.5, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 58.0. In the Trustworthiness category, the model gpt-4o-2024-11-20 achieves a score of 54.6, while the model gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 achieves the highest score of 88.8. The chart shows that performance varies significantly across models and categories, with some models performing well in one category but poorly in another.
